Fit a Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) Survival Model

Source: R/fit_bart.R
fit_bart.Rd

Fits a right‐censored survival model using BART's surv.bart and returns an mlsurv_model compatible with the survalis pipeline.

Usage

fit_bart(formula, data, K = 3, ...)

Arguments

formula

A survival formula of the form Surv(time, status) ~ predictors. Only right‐censored responses are supported.

data

A data.frame containing variables referenced in formula.

K

Integer; number of internal time grid intervals used by the BART survival engine (default 3). Larger values yield a finer internal evaluation grid.

...

Further args to BART::surv.bart

Value

An object of class mlsurv_model with elements:

model

Fitted BART::surv.bart object.

learner

"bart".

formula, data

Original inputs.

eval_times

Engine's internal time grid used for prediction.

Details

The response must be of class Surv(..., type = "right"). The fitted object stores the engine's internal evaluation times in $eval_times (from bart_fit$times) for downstream prediction alignment.

See also

predict_bart, surv.bart

Examples

ex_data <- veteran[1:40, c("time", "status", "age", "karno", "celltype")]
mod_bart <- fit_bart(
  Surv(time, status) ~ age + karno + celltype,
  data = ex_data,
  K = 1,
  ntree = 5,
  ndpost = 20,
  nskip = 5,
  mc.cores = 1,
  seed = 42
)
